{{Wireless adapter |brand=Edimax |model=EW-7722 |revision=In |upc=649659022669 |ean= |asin=B0067I4Y2O |price= |availability=common |est_release_date= |fcc_date=02/04/2010 |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=True |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=PCI |vendor_id=1814 |device_id=3062 |subvendor_id=1432 |subdevice_id=7722 |fcc_id=NDD9577220912 |chip1_brand=Ralink |chip1_model=RT3062 |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn=RP-SMA |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} [http://www.edimax.com/en/produce_detail.php?pd_id=345&pl1_id=1&pl2_id=44 Product Page] :2T2R MIMO "1242-00000292-01Z" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. ===Linux driver=== *[http://m.linux-hardware-guide.com/2012-07-28-edimax-ew-7612pln-300mbps-wireless-pci-e Linux Hardware Guide] The Edimax EW-7722In is a PCI card for WiFi connection up to 300 Mbit/s. :The card has the PCI ID 1814:3062: '''lspci''' 
02:01.0 Network controller [0280]: Ralink corp. Device [1814:3062]
    Subsystem: Edimax Computer Co. Device [1432:7722]
    Kernel driver in use: rt2800pci
    Kernel modules: rt3562sta, rt2800pci
:and bases on the [[Ralink]] RT3062F chipset ([[rt3290sta]]). The card is fully supported by the Linux kernel modules [[rt3562sta]] and [[rt2800pci]] :and is automatically recognized and initialized (since at least Ubuntu 11.10): '''dmesg''' 
rt2800pci 0000:02:09.0: PCI INT A -> GSI 21 (level, low) -> IRQ 21
Registered led device: rt2800pci-phy0::radio
Registered led device: rt2800pci-phy0::assoc
Registered led device: rt2800pci-phy0::quality
rt3562sta: module license 'unspecified' taints kernel.
rt2800pci 0000:02:09.0: PCI INT A disabled
rt2800pci 0000:02:09.0: PCI INT A -> GSI 21 (level, low) -> IRQ 21
See also [[Conceptronic C300Ri v3]].. ([https://forum.ubuntuusers.de/topic/doppelseitiges-problem-wlan-kabel/#post-2739482 Linux_sta driver], [https://wiki.debian.org/rt2800pci rt2800pci])
